# `provider_allocation_preview`

**Preview a provider worker allocation.** Show what one provider allocation would change -- the selected profiles before and after, the provider-wide ceiling, the sessions it drains and the busy set an interrupt would need, the pins and manual agents it leaves alone -- with the token apply consumes, without changing anything.

|---|---|

| Side effect | `read` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
